process.label: Process
process.annotation: Every step tracked in your client space
title: From first message
to handover.
process.lead: No guessing where things stand. Each step has an owner, a date and a record you can open any time.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Tell me what you need: goals, features, budget, deadline, references. Attach anything that helps.

steps.title: Review & questions
steps.text: I read everything within 24 hours and come back with the questions that change the estimate.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: A written scope: deliverables, price, payment terms, timeline, included revisions and what's out of scope.

steps.title: Deposit
steps.text: You accept the proposal and pay the deposit by CCP, BaridiMob, cash or card. Work starts the same week.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Milestones, progress updates and preview links in your client space. Messages and files stay in one place.

steps.title: Your review
steps.text: You test the real thing. Revisions included in the proposal are handled before anything is final.

steps.title: Final payment & delivery
steps.text: The balance is settled, then the source code, accounts and credentials are handed over.

steps.title: Closure & support
steps.text: Fixes during the warranty period are free. After that, keep me on a monthly plan or call when you need me.

title: Start
a project.
start.lead: Five short steps with a live estimate. I read every request myself and reply within 24 hours.
start.projectTitleHelp: A few words, e.g. "Booking site for my guesthouse".
start.objectivesHelp: Who uses it, what problem it solves, what success looks like.
start.requirementsHelp: Must-haves, integrations, platforms, anything already decided.
start.budgetHelp: A range is fine. It helps me propose the right scope, not the highest price.
start.linksHelp: Sites or apps you like, competitors, your current site. One per line.
start.filesHint: Briefs, mock-ups, screenshots, docs. Up to 25 MB each, 10 files
start.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. You'll use it to follow your project.
start.doneText: Your reference is {ref}. A confirmation is on its way to {email}. You can follow everything from your client space.
start.pausedText: I take a small number of projects at a time so each one gets full attention. New requests open again soon; you can still write to me with questions.
start.signInLead: Your request saves to your account as you type, so you can stop and finish it later, on any device.
start.estimateNote: A guide based on your choices. The final price comes in my proposal, after I read your request.
start.estimatePending: Pick a service to see an estimate.
start.ndaHelp: I won't show it in my portfolio or on social media.
start.saveError: Not saved yet. Check your connection.
start.waitlistText: Leave your e-mail and I'll write to you before anyone else when I take new projects.
start.waitlistDone: You're on the list. I'll write to you first.
start.atCapacity: I'm working on the maximum number of projects right now, so each one gets full attention.
start.estimateConverted: No set price in this currency yet: converted from DZD at today's street rate.
start.serviceOtherHelp: Games in Unity and other projects, quoted on request.

settings.deleteLead: This erases your account and personal details. It can't be undone.
deleteFacts: Your name, e-mail, phone numbers and usernames are wiped, and you can't sign in any more.
Unsent drafts and notifications are deleted.
Reviews you published stay on the website, without your name.
Signed contracts, invoices and payments are kept without your name, because accounting law requires it.
If a project is being built, finish or cancel it first.
